name: 🛡️ Постоянный профиль (Persistent Anti-Detect)
description: Использует сохранённый профиль Chrome в папке browser_profiles/stealth. Позволяет один раз пройти Cloudflare, сохранить куки и не вызывать подозрения антифрода Notion.

selectors.email_input: input[type='email'], input[placeholder*='name@company.com' i], input[placeholder*='email' i], input[type='text']
selectors.onboarding_work: text='For work', text='With my team', text='For my team', text='Work', [data-testid='onboarding-for-work']
selectors.skip_buttons: button:has-text('Skip'), button:has-text('Skip for now'), text='Skip', text='Skip for now'
selectors.free_plan: text='Free plan', text='Free', button:has-text('Continue with Free'), [data-testid='free-plan-card']
selectors.new_teamspace_btn: button:has-text('New teamspace'), text='New teamspace', text='Create a teamspace'
selectors.start_trial_btn: button:has-text('Start free trial'), text='Start free trial', button:has-text('Try Business'), text='Upgrade to Business'
